Your activity How it works

Everything runs on this computer: code runs in Docker or your browser, and the AI runs on Ollama.

Local setup

Everything runs on this computer. Two local services power practice.

Ollama: the AI assistant, agent and interviewer

Install Ollama, then download a chat model with tool support. A 7–9B model gives the most realistic agent:

ollama pull qwen3:8b

For AI inline suggestions in the editor, add a small fill-in-the-middle model:

ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:3b

Docker Desktop: code execution

Coding questions, Python repos and real-world repos run in disposable containers with no network access. Guided JavaScript repos run inside your browser.
